overview: Burbage called from Holywell, and named himself and the place. The marshal's men are off the gates. The Rose opens Monday, and so does the company, the same afternoon, and the town may choose. He wanted every leaf of Verona tonight. You said Sunday, after church, and when he asked what orchard you said Sunday again. He has had the king's roll five days and worn a hole where the crown goes. Garnish will not write him another. You told him to con it by the hole. You did not describe a yard, a heaven, or a coat of paint.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Named Sunday, and would not unpack the leaves tonight.
